question.problem: Find, in point-slope form, the equation of the line that passes through the point $(6,2)$ and has a slope of $4.$
question.worked_solution:
Using $m=4$ and $(x_1,y_1) = (6,2)$, we substitute into the point-slope formula:

$$
\begin{aligned}y-{y}_{1} & =m(x-{x}_{1}) \\ y-2 & =4(x-6)\end{aligned}
$$
